title: Local store service and place model
goal: Places persist on the owner's machine through a validated API
acceptance: `server/`: Node 24 native TypeScript service with `node:sqlite` on the owner's machine, data folder and `server/config.local.json` git-ignored; the Angular app talks only to it (no IndexedDB store)
Place schema (name, description, category, tags, notes, location, time spent) with validated create/read/update/delete
Regression tests over the API with invented places; the app reads places through one service
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Done 2026-11-25 in #5 (CI 45713057220 green): server/ (node:sqlite store, places API, local config), shared place model and validation in src/app/core/place.ts, PlacesApi client, docs/DESIGN.md; tests written first. No actual: start time not recorded.
